name: TransSahara Benghazi Data Center
notes: DataCenterMap listing identifies a 1 MW TransSahara facility in Benghazi and says the operator launched Libya's first commercial data center in 2020. Libya Herald reported the 2019 Trans-Saharan/Tatweer Tier 3 data-centre agreement was signed in Benghazi, but did not give a precise site location.

name: Al-Madar Al-Jadid Benghazi Data Centre / Root Server Site
notes: Libya Herald, citing the General Authority for Communications and Informatics, reported root servers operating from Al-Madar Al-Jadid data centres in Tripoli and Benghazi under the 2023-2027 national telecoms strategy.

name: Libya Telecom & Technology Modular Data Center - Benghazi
notes: In-Site portfolio page says it was commissioned by RETELIT MED to integrate modular data-centre technology and create the data container for LTT projects in Tripoli and Benghazi; source does not state capacity or completion date.
